description: This PHP class 'Ip' is part of the Opencart fraud detection extension. It provides methods to check if an IP address is potentially fraudulent based on stored IP data and the order information.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: Class for checking IP addresses against a fraud database to determine if an order should be flagged, within the Opencart fraud extension.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if the IP associated with an order is flagged as suspicious based on stored IP records.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves IP details from the database to assist in fraud detection.
